verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM has a first-party docs section titled "MCP Compatibility in AnythingLLM", which points to its own MCP integration for its agent. The pack contains only the page title, though, so it is unclear how servers are added and how their tools reach the agent. The probe item calls this an "official MCP server", but that describes the server role and does not establish client-side tool use. Missing for 10: documented steps for registering or configuring MCP servers, supported transports, how MCP tools are exposed to the @agent, and hands-on or community confirmation that it works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
